scope: Controlled native UI against deterministic in-memory fixture providers. No processing engine or physical/headset acceptance is claimed.
limits: Graph has two consecutive unchanged passes per platform at the component/layout checkpoint; later caption theme changes are covered by source/types and affected browser verification.
Expression has two consecutive unchanged passes per platform after the Android focus-state cleanup.
The keyboard fragment has one replay per platform and requires a fresh expression flow first; it is not an independent standalone QA scenario.

Some idle checks retained small-region-change warnings. Explicit document, loaded-source and completion/diagnostic gates passed. Android graph pass 2 had two such warnings; their moving region was not separately classified.
The task-owned Android APK had previously been speed-compiled to repair the emulator's ART startup issue. Unoptimized cold startup remains unverified.
Remaining native controls, physical accessibility/narration, desktop and headset gates remain open.
